banners.prompt:
Create a photorealistic product mockup of a printed paperback book standing slightly angled, turned a little to the LEFT so that we see the front cover and the white page edges on the RIGHT side of the book. The spine is NOT visible: no spine, no back cover and no text anywhere except the front cover. Physically correct perspective like a real product photo on a pure white background, soft natural shadow under it. The book fills about 75% of the frame height and is fully visible, nothing cropped.
FRONT COVER DESIGN - "kitten and tomcat": bright clean background, soft light blue fading to white. In the middle of the cover a small playful black-and-white kitten with one paw raised sits next to a big calm grey tomcat; both look at the viewer, photorealistic, soft studio light. Title at the top in dark navy, the word "ЩАСТЛИВА" and "ЩАСТЛИВ" in warm yellow-orange. Under the cats the letters "P.U.R.R." are large in dark navy with a small yellow cat paw print under each letter. Subtitle below in dark navy. Yellow round badge with dark text in the top-left corner. Bottom: a navy strip with four simple white line icons (sofa, cable plug, hand, rug) - icons only, no text.
TEXT ON THE COVER (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Title line 1: "ЩАСТЛИВА КОТКА,"
2) Title line 2: "ЩАСТЛИВ СТОПАНИН"
3) Subtitle, smaller, 3-4 lines: "Научи как с лесната система P.U.R.R. за котенца и възрастни котки, да избегнеш надраскани мебели, изядени кабели, хапане и „изненади“ по килима."
4) Round badge, 3 short lines: "ПРАКТИЧНО" / "ЛЕСНО" / "ПОЛЕЗНО"
Text 5) the large letters under the cats: "P.U.R.R."

TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic. Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character, including punctuation and quotation marks. Do not translate, correct, shorten, re-order or add any words.
- Heavy, clean sans-serif with full Cyrillic (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black style) for the title; clean regular sans-serif for the subtitle. Large and clearly legible on a phone.
- No other text, logos, watermarks, prices, author names or website addresses anywhere.
CATS: ordinary domestic cats like the ones Bulgarians keep (tabby, black-and-white, grey, ginger), not exotic breeds; natural anatomy, four legs, correct eyes. NO people anywhere, no faces; if a hand appears it is gender-neutral (no nails polish, no jewellery, no sleeve).
STYLE: premium, warm, friendly, clean professional design like a bestselling publisher would use.
